name: PD 148 was established by Ordinance No. 17814, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 27, 1983. Ordinance No. 17814 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 17814 was amended by Ordinance No. 23285, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 24, 1997. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17814; 23285; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 148 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-148.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 148 was established by Ordinance No. 17814, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 27, 1983. Ordinance No. 17814 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 17814 was amended by Ordinance No. 23285, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 24, 1997. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17814; 23285; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-148.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 148 is established on property generally located at the north corner of Fairmount Avenue and Enid Street. The size of PD 148 is approximately 1.77 acres. (Ord. Nos. 17814; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-148.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plans
sections.text: SEC. 51P-148.104.DEVELOPMENT PLANS. Development and use of the Property must comply with either Development Plan A (Exhibit 148A) or Development Plan B (Exhibit 148B). (Ord. Nos. 23285; 25508)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text: SEC. 51P-148.105.MAIN USES PERMITTED. The uses permitted in this district are all uses permitted in the O-2 Office District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the O-2 Office District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code. For example, a use permitted in the O-2 Office District by specific use permit (SUP) only is permitted in this PD by SUP only. A use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the O-2 Office District is subject to DIR in this PD, etc. (Ord. Nos. 23285; 25508)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-148.106.ACCESSORY USES. As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51-4.217. (Ord. Nos. 23285; 25508)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-148.107.YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REQUIREMENTS.
(a)In general. Except as provided below, the yard, lot, and space regulations specified for the O-2 Office District in Division 51-4.400 apply to this PD.
(b)Development Plan A (Office/Attached Single-Family Development Plan).
(1)Front and side yard setbacks. Minimum setbacks along certain streets in this PD are as follows:
(A)Fairmount Street - 40 feet.
(B)Enid Street - 20 feet.
(C)Routh Street - 25 feet.
(D)West property line:
(i)Office uses - 30 feet.
(ii)Residential uses - 15 feet.
(2)Floor area.A maximum of 220,000 square feet is permitted, of which a maximum of 15,000 square feet of residential structure floor area may be included.
(3)Height.
(A)Maximum office structure height is 215 feet.
(B)Maximum residential structure height is 36 feet.
(4)Dwelling units. Maximum number of residential dwelling units permitted is nine attached dwelling units.
(5)Floor area ratio. Maximum floor area ratio is three to one.
(c)Development Plan B (Multiple-Family Development Plan).
(1)Setbacks. Front, side, and rear yard setbacks are as shown on Development Plan
B.
(2)Floor area. Maximum floor area permitted is 220,000 square feet.
(3)Dwelling units. Maximum number of dwelling units permitted is 154.
(4)Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 80 percent.
(5)Height.
(A)Maximum structure height for the first 60 feet of the Property fronting Routh Street is 70 feet at the north portion of the Property, increasing to a height of 80 feet at the south portion of the Property, as shown on Development Plan B.
(B)In all other cases, maximum structure height is 115 feet. (Ord. Nos. 23285; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-148.108.PARKING.
(a)Development Plan A. Parking must be provided at a ratio of one space per 333 square feet of office uses, and one space per 500 square feet of residential uses, with a minimum of one space per unit and a maximum of two spaces per unit for residential uses.
(b)Development Plan B. A minimum of 298 off-street parking spaces must be provided.
(c)In general. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Division 51-4.300) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 23285; 25508)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-148.109.LANDSCAPING.
(a)Development Plan A. Landscaping for development in accordance with Development Plan A must be completed in accordance with Article X, and must be provided as follows:
(1)All front yards and side yards must have trees (live oak, magnolia, or other evergreen trees) at least four inches in diameter and no further than 20 feet apart within the perimeter of the parkway area. The remaining landscaping and screening must be provided as shown on Development Plan A. All the landscaping must have an automatic underground sprinkler system.
(2)The location of all landscape material within the street right-of-way must be approved by the director of streets, sanitation, and code enforcement prior to any planting.
(3)A maintenance agreement for maintaining all landscape material within the street right-of-way must be approved by the director of streets, sanitation, and code enforcement prior to any planting. All landscaping must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times.
(b)Development Plan B. Prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for development in accordance with Development Plan B, landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan labelled Landscape Plan B (Exhibit 148C). Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 23285; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-148.110.SIGNS. Signs must comply with provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Division 51- 7.400. (Ord. Nos. 23285; 25508)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-148.111.ACCESS.
(a)Development Plan A. No vehicular access from Routh Street is permitted.
(b)Development Plan B. A maximum of 42 off-street parking spaces may be accessed from Routh Street. Each parking level may access one street only, and no two levels may access the same street, or another parking level. (Ord. Nos. 23285; 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan Development Schedule
sections.text: SEC. 51P-148.112.DEVELOPMENT PLAN DEVELOPMENT SCHEDULE. The residential units must be constructed simultaneously with the office building. (Ord. Nos. 23285; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-148.113.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23285; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-148.114.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 23285; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-148.115.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 23285; 25508)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-148.116.ZONING MAP. PD 148 is located on Zoning Map No. I-7. (Ord. Nos. 17814; 25508)
